description.text: The eighth Scarlet & Violet set, released on 8 November 2024 with 191 cards plus secret rares. Pikachu ex leads it as a Stellar Tera Pokémon ex, with a parade of Dragon Pokémon led by Alolan Exeggutor ex, Archaludon ex and Latias ex, and its theme is the Terarium of The Indigo Disk. It has more ACE SPEC cards, and its rarest include six gold etched hyper rares.
